mahavira-born-jain-teacher.reason: The ascetic is shown fully nude and frontal, with pubic hair and genitals visible at the centre of the frame. Repaint with the lower body covered or turned away, for example in a loincloth or seen from behind or the side, keeping the tree, the discarded robe and the adult standing pose.
mahavira-born-jain-teacher.description: An oil painting of a thin adult man with long hair, eyes closed, standing barefoot and fully nude, facing the viewer, in a dark forest before a large banyan-like tree. A gold-embroidered red cloth lies on the ground at his feet. No text, no frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

tao-te-ching-written.description: An elderly bearded man with a bald head and long white beard, in a loose tan robe, rides a dark water buffalo with large curved horns. He leans forward to hand a bundle of bound bamboo slips to a guard in lamellar armour with a topknot, who reaches up from the right. They stand before a wooden gate in a stone wall with a tiled roof, under misty dark mountains, with a torch burning at the right edge and a small torch far back on the left. The scene is dim and painted in warm browns and ochres. A tiny faint mark sits in the bottom-right corner.

ashoka-converts-after-kalinga.description: A bearded man in an ornate gold-and-iron crown and torn red cloak with gold armour stands on a smoky battlefield, head bowed, one hand resting on a sword planted in the ground. Broken spears, shields and bodies lie around him, with dark silhouetted soldiers in the background. Behind him, to the right, a bald monk in a saffron robe holds a bowl and raises his palms together. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no visible text or border.

celestial-masters-founded.description: A robed, white-bearded sage with a topknot floats in glowing golden clouds, arms outstretched, above misty pine-covered mountains. In the lower right, a bearded man with a topknot kneels on a rocky outcrop with his hands pressed together in prayer, gazing up at him. Dark, moody oil-painting style with no visible text, border or frame; the painting runs edge to edge.

kojiki-records-shinto-myths.description: Two figures in ancient East Asian-style robes stand on a rickety rope bridge over a churning, storm-dark sea under swirling clouds. The man on the left, with a topknot, grips a jewelled spear whose tip drips water into the waves. The woman on the right, with long black hair, holds a long jewelled staff. No text, frame or border is visible; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

adi-shankara-born.description: A seated robed man in orange and saffron cloth, with white forehead markings, holds a palm-leaf manuscript and a tall staff under a large spreading tree beside a river at sunset. Three seated figures with their backs or profiles to the viewer sit around him, and a brass pot rests by his side. Palm trees line the far bank, and the scene is painted in a warm oil style with no visible text, frame or border.

nichiren-declares-teaching.description: A shaven-headed man in dark loose robes stands on a rocky cliff edge, hands pressed together at chest height with a prayer bead strand hanging from them, face turned to the left. Behind him a low sun glows orange through dramatic grey clouds over a calm sea, with gnarled pine trees on the rocks. No text, no border, no visible era-specific machinery; the scene is painterly and dim.

tsongkhapa-founds-ganden.description: A robed lama in a yellow pointed hat holds an open book and gestures, while maroon-robed monks in yellow hats carry large stones up a rocky slope. Behind them are whitewashed multi-storey buildings with red-trimmed roofs and scaffolding, under a stormy sky with dark mountains. The style is an oil-like painting with no visible text, signature, frame or border.

guru-nanak-born.description: A bearded man in a light robe and tan turban sits under a large, gnarled banyan-like tree with hanging aerial roots, one hand raised in speech. Beside him, a younger man in a turban sits on a rock playing a long-necked lute (rabab). Soft golden light breaks through the leaves, and a dim open landscape fades into a dusky sky. The style is a dark, warm oil painting, with no visible text, frame or border.

dalai-lama-title-created.description: A man in an ornate fur-trimmed brown and gold robe and fur hat leans forward with an open hand toward a seated monk in a yellow hat and red robe. The monk raises one hand and sits on a carved wooden throne. The setting is a round felt tent with lattice walls, a lit candle, and a brazier fire in the foreground. A doorway opens onto a moonlit lake, and two attendants stand in shadow at left.
